import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/devtests')
from qlib import *

FAILS = []
def check(name, cond, extra=''):
    if cond:
        print('ok   ', name)
    else:
        print('FAIL ', name, extra)
        FAILS.append(name)

def status(res, idx=0, trace=0):
    return res['traces'][trace]['packets'][idx]['status']

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- multiple envelopes
w = long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01') + long_header('H', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')
t = trace([keys('I','H'), dg(w, [0,0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('multi.status0', status(r,0)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('multi.status1', status(r,1)=='OK', r['packets'][1])
check('multi.packet1.offset', r['packets'][1]['offset']==len(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')), r['packets'][1])
ci = long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')
ch = long_header('H', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')
check('multi.datagram.bytes', r['datagrams'][1]['bytes']==len(ci)+len(ch), r['datagrams'][1])
check('multi.datagram.hash', r['datagrams'][1]['sha256']==sha(ci+ch), r['datagrams'][1])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- bad header
w = long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')
bad = bytearray(w); bad[1]=2   # version 2
t = trace([dg(bytes(bad), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('badver.status', status(r)=='BAD_HEADER', r['packets'][0])
check('badver.level', r['packets'][0]['level'] is None and r['packets'][0]['pn'] is None)
check('badver.datagram', r['datagrams'][0]=={'event':0,'packets':1,'accepted':0,'bytes':0,'sha256':sha(b'')}, r['datagrams'][0])

# truncated long header
t = trace([dg(w[:5], [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('trunc.status', status(r)=='BAD_HEADER', r['packets'][0])

# unsupported long type (0-RTT 0x80)
w2 = bytes([0x80]) + w[1:]
t = trace([dg(w2, [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('zerortt.status', status(r)=='BAD_HEADER', r['packets'][0])

# bad reserved bits in short header (0x58 -> reserved bit set)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(bytes([0x58])+b'\xaa\x00\x01', [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('shortreserved.status', status(r)=='BAD_HEADER', r['packets'][0])

# claimed length too long
w3 = bytearray(w); w3[13]=0x0a   # length field says 10 but only 1 payload byte present
t = trace([dg(bytes(w3), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('badlen.status', status(r)=='BAD_HEADER', r['packets'][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- drop cid
w = long_header('I', b'\xcc', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')
t = trace([dg(w, [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('dropcid.status', status(r)=='DROP_CID', r['packets'][0])
check('dropcid.pn', r['packets'][0]['pn']==0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- no key
w = long_header('H', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x01')
t = trace([dg(w, [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('nokey.status', status(r)=='NO_KEY', r['packets'][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pn range
w = long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0xFFFFFFFF, b'\x01', pnlen=4)
t = trace([dg(w, [0])], received={'I':2**62-1,'H':None,'A':None})
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('pnrange.status', status(r)=='PN_RANGE', r['packets'][0])
check('pnrange.pn', r['packets'][0]['pn']==2**62+0xFFFFFFFF, r['packets'][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- duplicate
w = long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 3, b'\x01')
t = trace([dg(w, [0]), dg(w, [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('dup.status0', status(r,0)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('dup.status1', status(r,1)=='DUPLICATE', r['packets'][1])
check('dup.received', r['received']['I']==3, r['received'])

# seed makes the seed packet number a duplicate
t = trace([dg(w, [0])], received={'I':3,'H':None,'A':None})
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('dupseed.status', status(r)=='DUPLICATE', r['packets'][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- auth
w = short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x01')
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(w, [])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('auth.null', status(r)=='AUTH', r['packets'][0])
check('auth.epochnull', r['packets'][0]['epoch'] is None)

# epoch out of range
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(w, [3])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('auth.epochrange', status(r)=='AUTH', r['packets'][0])

# parity mismatch: epoch 1 with key phase 0
w = short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x01', keyphase=0)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(w, [1])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('auth.parity', status(r)=='AUTH', r['packets'][0])

# epoch 1 with key phase 1 -> accepted, current epoch advances
w = short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x01', keyphase=1)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(w, [1])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('epoch.advance', status(r)=='OK' and r['key_epoch']==1, (r['packets'][0], r['key_epoch']))
check('epoch.rows', r['epochs']==[{'epoch':0,'min':0,'max':0,'count':1},{'epoch':1,'min':0,'max':0,'count':1}], r['epochs'])

# key update error: epoch 0 pn 10 then epoch 1 pn 5
w0 = short_header(b'\xaa', 10, b'\x01', keyphase=0)
w1 = short_header(b'\xaa', 5, b'\x01', keyphase=1)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(w0, [0]), dg(w1, [1])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('keyupdate.status', status(r,1)=='KEY_UPDATE_ERROR', r['packets'][1])
check('keyupdate.closed', r['closed']=={'event':2,'packet':0,'offset':0,'code':'KEY_UPDATE_ERROR'}, r['closed'])
check('keyupdate.epoch', r['packets'][1]['epoch']==1, r['packets'][1])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame errors
# unsupported frame type
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x20'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('unsupported.type', status(r)=='FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', r['packets'][0])
check('unsupported.closed', r['closed']=={'event':0,'packet':0,'offset':0,'code':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'}, r['closed'])

# non minimal frame type
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x40\x01'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('nonminimal.type', status(r)=='FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', r['packets'][0])

# server only frame from client
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x1e'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('serveronly.status', status(r)=='PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', r['packets'][0])

# reset stream in an initial packet
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x04\x00\x00\x00'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('level.reset', status(r)=='PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', r['packets'][0])

# empty payload
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b''), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('empty.payload', status(r)=='FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR' and r['closed']['offset']==0, r['packets'][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rollback
# a valid stream frame followed by an invalid frame -> nothing committed
payload = b'\x0b\x00\x01a' + b'\x20'
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, payload), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('rollback.status', status(r)=='FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', r['packets'][0])
check('rollback.offset', r['closed']['offset']==4, r['closed'])
check('rollback.streams', r['streams']==[], r['streams'])
check('rollback.used', r['used']==0 and r['opened']=={'bidi':0,'uni':0}, r)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- peer close
payload = b'\x1c\x00\x00\x00\x00'
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, payload), [0]), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, b'\x01'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('close.status', status(r,0)=='PEER_CLOSE', r['packets'][0])
check('close.closed', r['closed']=={'event':1,'packet':0,'offset':0,'code':'PEER_CLOSE'}, r['closed'])
check('close.next', status(r,1)=='CLOSED', r['packets'][1])
check('close.accepted', r['datagrams'][1]['accepted']==1 and r['datagrams'][2]['accepted']==0, r['datagrams'])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ack
# ACK frame: largest=10, delay=0, count=1, first=2 -> range [8,10]; gap=1 range=1 -> low=8 >= 1+2 ok, high=8-1-2=5, range 1<=5 -> [4,5]
ack = b'\x02' + varint(10) + varint(0) + varint(1) + varint(2) + varint(1) + varint(1)
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, ack), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('ack.status', status(r)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
a = r['acknowledged'][0]
check('ack.count', a['count']==4, a)
check('ack.intervals', a['intervals']==2, a)
check('ack.prefix', a['prefix']==0, a)
import hashlib
h = hashlib.sha256(b''.join(x.to_bytes(8,'big') for x in (4,5,8,11))).hexdigest()
check('ack.hash', a['sha256']==h, (a['sha256'],h))

# ack first > largest
ack = b'\x02' + varint(5) + varint(0) + varint(0) + varint(6)
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, ack), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('ack.bad', status(r)=='FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', r['packets'][0])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- crypto
crypto = b'\x06' + varint(0) + varint(3) + b'abc'
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, crypto), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('crypto.status', status(r)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
c = r['crypto'][0]
check('crypto.ranges', c['ranges']==[[0,3]] and c['unique']==3 and c['prefix']==3, c)
check('crypto.hash', c['sha256']==sha(b'abc'), c)

# conflicting crypto overlap
crypto2 = b'\x06' + varint(1) + varint(2) + b'xy'
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, crypto), [0]), dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 1, crypto2), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('crypto.conflict', status(r,1)=='PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', r['packets'][1])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- padding
t = trace([dg(long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x00\x00\x01'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
canon = long_header('I', b'\xaa', b'\xbb', 0, b'\x00\x00\x01', pnlen=1)
check('padding.status', status(r)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('padding.canonical', r['packets'][0]['sha256']==sha(canon), (r['packets'][0]['sha256'], sha(canon)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- connection ids
ncid = b'\x18' + varint(1) + varint(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + bytes(16)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, ncid), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('ncid.status', status(r)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('ncid.peers', r['peer_cids']==[{'sequence':0,'id':'cc','token':'00'*16},{'sequence':1,'id':'dd','token':'00'*16}], r['peer_cids'])

# same sequence with different cid -> protocol violation
ncid2 = b'\x18' + varint(1) + varint(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xee' + bytes(16)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, ncid), [0]), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, ncid2), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('ncid.mismatch', status(r,1)=='PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', r['packets'][1])

# retire connection id
ret = b'\x19' + varint(1)
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, ret), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('retire.status', status(r)=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('retire.local', r['retired_local']==[[1,2]], r['retired_local'])
# a later packet addressed to the retired cid is dropped
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, ret), [0]), dg(short_header(b'\xbb', 1, b'\x01'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('retire.drop', status(r,1)=='DROP_CID', r['packets'][1])

# retire the cid this packet is addressed to -> protocol violation
t = trace([keys('A'), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, ret), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]

print()
print('failures:', FAILS)
sys.exit(1 if FAILS else 0)
